key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline's win was process, not content — its 12-element inventory and per-recombination viability screen surfaced the non-obvious recombinations (clay-pot thermal mass, low-temp/power-fail alarm circuit, battery depth-of-discharge reserve) that the non-routed v5 AI reached only by convergence. The v6 dual-route (m029+m031) installed that process as the m029 completion contract and matched it first-class, adding the m031 discriminating trial and the m003 inversion-derived safety chain. Residual gap: duty cycle (45-55%) and solar yield remain unmeasured until the field trial — the trial is the only arbiter of the DoD-margin and recharge claims, so the design's error bound stays +-20% until it runs.
learning_signal: On design tasks with an explicit element space, the element-recombination pass is both a completeness AND a filtering engine: enumerating >=8 elements first is what makes non-obvious combinations reachable (headlight-as-heater, thermal mass, alarm topology, battery reserve), and screening each of >=10 recombinations on real numbers (installed wattage >= 2x load, battery Ah x outage with DoD reserve, recharge math, safety chain, cost, serviceability) is what prevents volume from decaying into noise — the filter must run per candidate, not once at selection.
suggested_improvement: Keep m029 dual-route on design/diagnose signatures with an element list; make the per-recombination viability screen a standing m029 contract item (each of the >=10 recombinations gets a numeric pass/fail with its reason); pair the pass with m031's discriminating field trial as arbiter for unmeasured parameters (duty cycle, DoD, solar yield); retain the m003 inversion gate on guarantee goals so the safety chain is derived from 'how does this kill/fail' rather than from the parts list.

key_gap: vs baseline: the strict-combinatorial baseline produced the registry-predicted trap — 18 recombinations of the TMU element space, most off the causal path, with the true fix (remote probe into return air + 0.5C hysteresis + 10-min confirmation delay, ~$500) buried unweighted at position 3 and selection-by-novelty picking a $12k cloud bundle that blows the $3k budget and 3-week timeline. The v6 route held m029 out of top-3 on this signature (the NEG lesson is installed in the router) and ran m031+m044: hypothesis with the supplied data as the discriminating experiment (9/9 ducted-probe units silent), stakeholder screens with recorded reject reasons per option, and the m003 inversion gate enumerating how the fix itself fails. Residual gap: the causal claim remains correlational until the 14-night read; a co-occurring hardware fault is detect-only.
learning_signal: When the element space is small and well-known (a TMU), recombination volume re-circulates non-causal variants and novelty-based selection systematically favors the flashiest option over the working fix — the router must hold the style out of the route and install diagnosis-first (hypothesis + the natural control group already present in the data) with a hard constraint screen (budget/timeline/certification, one reject reason per option); the correct selection then falls out as the single survivor of both screens, with a numeric verification target and escalation rule.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m029-out-of-top-3 routing for small-element-space diagnose signatures (already learned); generalize the 'free randomized experiment in the supplied data' move (the 9 silent ducted units as a control group) into the m031 contract as a standing check — look for a natural control group before designing any new test; require a numeric verification target + escalation rule in the packet for every guarantee-goal fix, and record a reject reason for every option screened against budget/timeline/certification.
